info.name: Souk-AI API
info.description:
Souk-AI Laravel REST API collection. Base URL: http://localhost/api

AUTHENTICATION:
- Login is SESSION/COOKIE based (Laravel web middleware + Sanctum). Postman will keep the session cookie in its jar after a successful login.
- Register returns a Bearer token; for cookie-based routes the session cookie is what counts.
- All /admin, /store and /shipping routes require auth + a role (admin / store / shipping_company).
- If you hit 419 (CSRF token mismatch), first GET {{baseUrl}}/sanctum/csrf-cookie, then include the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on state-changing requests.

VARIABLES:
- {baseUrl}: {{baseUrl}}
- {token}: bearer token from Register (not used for cookie auth)

Paths with {id}/{slug}/{category} placeholders must be filled with real ids.
